bio: Celebrate a truly quintessential British Afternoon Tea at The Montagu Kitchen, located at five-star Hyatt Regency London – The Churchill overlooking Portman Square Gardens in Marylebone. Tucked away behind bustling Oxford Street and ideally located to explore the boutique shops and characterful streets of the London village of Marylebone, experience impeccable service and an occasion to remember.  Sip The Montagu Kitchen’s signature tea blend ‘Roses in Bloom and indulge in a delectable selection of hallmark pastries by our talented Chefs, alongside scones, jams and a selection of savouries and sandwiches. Afternoon Tea is served every Thursday, Friday, and Saturday from 2 pm to 5 pm.  Montagu Kitchen Afternoon Tea - £46 Champagne Afternoon Tea with a glass of Champagne - £60 Afternoon tea with a glass of Mocktail - £54  Two Hours of soft drinks Afternoon Tea - £65
